title: Fixed cell selection around merged cells: a selection now always covers every merged cell it touches, a merged cell whose rows a filter hides no longer extends the selection over other cells, and an arrow key pressed after Tab or Enter inside a range moves on from the focused cell, not from a merged cell the focus skipped. The `beforeSelectionHighlightSet`, `modifyTransformStart`, `modifyTransformEnd`, `beforeSelectionFocusSet`, and `afterSelectionFocusSet` hooks now receive a range, a step, or a focused cell already adjusted for merged cells.
